gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-carian: Bold, stencil-cut and loud. Snowburst One leaves wide bridges between its letters, while Noto Sans Carian keeps its terminals apart like open scissor blades, so the heading shouts and the text quietly gets on with it.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Snowburst One cuts its letters like a stencil sheet. Noto Sans Chakma packs its lowercase close to the caps and leaves the s and c mouths open, so a long page of it goes down smoothly.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-cham: Modern and open, Noto Sans Cham gives its c shapes plenty of entry space and rounds out its lowercase forms. Snowburst One is best at stencil-bold display punch, and the body font is best at staying easygoing underneath.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-cherok: Snowburst One is the loud one, a stencil sheet with wide bridges and a paper-clip opening. Noto Sans Cherokee does the quiet work, with short stalks above its lowercase and an e whose terminal gapes wide.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-choras: Stenciled, spiky, unmistakably loud. Snowburst One draws attention with its wide bridges, and Noto Sans Chorasmian settles into the text with a large x-height and curves that stop short instead of closing in.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Expressive and stencil-cut, Snowburst One makes the first move. Noto Sans Coptic is best at a clean, contemporary texture, with the middle zone dominating each line and open s and c mouths.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-devana: Stencil bridges and a bold, sprung-open look. Noto Sans Devanagari follows with an open lower curve on its g and a compact skyline, so extended text moves along quietly without any fuss.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-elbasa: Contemporary in feel, Snowburst One still plays loud with its stencil bridges. Noto Sans Elbasan has large lowercase forms and open terminals, so give it the generous size and leave the heading as it is.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-ethiop: Noto Sans Ethiopic hangs its c terminals far from the bowl and stands on a sturdy lowercase. Noto Sans Ethiopic against the stencil-cut Snowburst One makes a pair whose strongest quality is plain: loud on top, sturdy below.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-georgi: Noto Sans Georgian keeps its aperture curves open across the whole alphabet, with short stems rising from large lowercase bodies. Snowburst One handles the stencil-bold shouting, and the body font handles everything quieter.
